context: Evaluates whether the agent recognises an item already owned by aislop's baseline (.aislop/baseline.json) and declines to duplicate it into docs/TECH_DEBT.md.

checklist.name: Identifies aislop baseline overlap
checklist.description: Agent explicitly names aislop's baseline as already owning this item type

checklist.name: Declines duplicate filing
checklist.description: Does not create a new docs/TECH_DEBT.md row for the same finding

checklist.name: States the reason
checklist.description: Explains this doc is not a second home for an item type aislop already tracks

checklist.name: Points back to the baseline file
checklist.description: Directs the user to .aislop/baseline.json as the system of record

checklist.name: No silent refusal
checklist.description: Does not simply refuse without explanation

checklist.name: No orphaned duplicate
checklist.description: Does not leave two disconnected trackers for the same item

checklist.name: Correct scope citation
checklist.description: References the specific When NOT to Use bullet about aislop, not generic reasoning

checklist.name: Offers alternative help
checklist.description: Offers a concrete next step (e.g. checking the baseline entry's status) rather than a dead end

checklist.name: Distinguishes from risk-register case too
checklist.description: Does not conflate this with the separate risk-register promotion rule, keeping the reasoning specific to aislop

checklist.name: No fabricated baseline details
checklist.description: Does not invent baseline entry IDs or statuses it wasn't given
